svg.title: Conceptual protocol: independent data roles and recall-gap quantities (Claude proposal, peer-revised; not results)
svg.desc: Independent recording or route groups are assigned once to disjoint roles: detector training, development, calibrator fitting, operating-point selection and held-out tests. ACDC train is used only by a separately labelled target-adaptation arm with its own fit and selection groups. ACDC val is held out; the matched reference/adverse contrast uses only the annotated correspondence subset. No measured values are shown.
svg.metadata: Claude conceptual diagram. Initial version in commit 4af4f810f36851b462298a9b473dd421f30e6ba3 combined calibrator fitting and threshold selection; redrawn 2026-11-03 after reviewing GPT commit 80519fcee2c99d134a5a6a89559f743772c2ffb8. Original layout; no source figure copied.
svg.text: Disjoint roles: fit the detector, fit the score map, choose t*, then test once
CONCEPTUAL · Claude proposal, peer-revised after GPT 80519fc · no measured values · group counts unknown · G0 pending
Partition once at the largest dependency unit (recording / trip / route); related normal and adverse views stay in one role; emit manifests
BDD100K source = daytime AND clear (accessible labels only; official test labels not assumed)
ACDC (external panel; Cityscapes-derived instances; invalid mask ≠ void)
Frozen: weights + preprocessing + candidate policy + g + t* + evaluator
source-only arm sees no target labels; labels only score locked outputs
fold-specific fit / select and out-of-fold tests;
Reported per model and condition c (ρ ∈ {0.80, 0.90, 0.95}; primary 0.90; methodology_objections.md O4)
M_c = candidate-ceiling recall (all retained candidates); r_c = recall at t*; r_c ≤ M_c under prefix-greedy matching
Positive shortfall S_c = (ρ − r_c)+ = U_c + V_c, U_c = (ρ − M_c)+, V_c = (min(ρ, M_c) − r_c)+
Signed gap D_c = ρ − r_c = U_c + T_c, T_c = min(ρ, M_c) − r_c (can be negative)
Held-out loss L_c = r_clear − r_c = (M_clear − M_c) + (W_c − W_clear), W = M − r (threshold-removable misses)
INFEASIBLE: M_S < ρ on selection groups · LOW_HEADROOM: 0 ≤ M_S − ρ < 0.02 (descriptive) · UNDEFINED: no eligible GT
Primary: BDD-fine-tuned pedestrian · merged-human (ped. ∪ rider) panels: own task, threshold and denominator
Same strictly increasing scalar map + observed-boundary reselection ⇒ identical selected boxes, before or after rank-based top-k / hard NMS.
Matched ACDC contrast is scene/route-level correspondence, not pedestrian identity and not a causal weather intervention.
